loading_scale: latent-scale b with b_j^2 + psi_j = 1; sparsity concerns |b_j|, not its LD-direction sign
interpretation: descriptive loading-density diagnostic; does not fit or test a sparse-PCA estimator
effective_support_definition: (sum_j b_j^2)^2 / sum_j b_j^4; divide by p so 1 is an equal-magnitude dense loading vector
